Parts of the question to be attempted together.
1. (a) A researcher wants to investigate the impact of social media on students'
concentration. Explain how they should carry out the research process from identifying the problem to reporting the findings.
(b) Explain the meaning of propositions and hypotheses in research. Discuss the relationship between the two and their importance in the research
process. Support your answer with an example.
(c) Describe the different types of research based on purpose (exploratory, descriptive, causal), and assess how each contributes to business decision-
(d) Explain the role of a literature review in the research process. How does
it help in formulating a clear and focused research question ?
2. (a) Explain the meaning of research design and discuss any five characteristics that make a research design effective. 9
(b) Differentiate between exploratory, descriptive and experimental research
designs. Give suitable examples of each.
(c) Describe the methods used in descriptive research design, such as surveys, observations and case studies. Provide examples. 9
(d) Describe the role of experimental research design in establishing cause-and-effect relationships. Explain its types and illustrate with examples. 9
Explain the difference between probability and non-probability sampling techniques. Describe at least two methods from each category. 9
(b) Explain the meaning of primary and secondary data. Discuss their sources and give examples of when each type is appropriate. 9
(c) Compare the Likert scale, Semantic Differential scale and Stapel scale.
Discuss the advantages and limitations of each. 9
(d) Explain the steps involved in designing an effective questionnaire.
Discuss how on line tools have improved the process. 9
4. (a) Write a short note on the importance of for matting and presentation in research reports. How does it enhance readability and credibility? 9
(b) Explain the importance of graphical presentation of data in research.
Discuss common types of graphs and their uses.
(c) Write short note on the importance of hypothesis testing in research.
Include the role of significance levels. 9
(d) A food company claims that the mean weight of chocolate bars is 100
grams. A sample of 49 bars has a mean weight of 98.5 grams. Assume the population standard deviation is 3 grams. Test at 5% significance level whether the company's claim is valid. 9
Write short notes on any three : 6+6+6=18
(a) Qualitative and quantitative research
(b) Conceptual and empirical research
(c) Role of theory and model in research
(d) Frequency distribution and descriptive statistics
(e) Data preparation and cleaning for analysis.
